verdict.rationale: Capacities offers first-party Chat Connectors explicitly supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Le Chat, plus a documented REST API with Bearer/OAuth2 auth and an official MCP integration path confirmed live by probe. This directly satisfies connecting external LLMs/AI tools via first-party connectors. Missing for 10: no evidence of a broader third-party plugin ecosystem or independent hands-on confirmation of these connectors working in practice.
